description: This Java class 'ObjectType' provides utilities for analyzing, converting, and comparing object types in Java, including class loading, type checking, and type conversion methods, with reflection and support for various data types.

classes.name: ObjectType.NullObject
classes.description: A singleton class representing a null object, implementing Serializable, with custom toString, hashCode, and equals methods.

methods.name: loadClass
methods.description: Loads a class by name using the current thread's context classloader or a specified classloader, handling primitives, arrays, and aliases.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Creates a new instance of a class by name using its no-arg constructor.

methods.name: instanceOf
methods.description: Checks if a class or object is a subclass or implements an interface, given a type name.

methods.name: loadInfoClass
methods.description: Helper method to load class for a given type name, trying different package prefixes.

methods.name: simpleTypeOrObjectConvert
methods.description: Converts an object to a specified type, supporting various data types, with optional formatting, locale, and timezone.

methods.name: doRealCompare
methods.description: Performs comparison between two objects based on operator, type, and format, returning Boolean result.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Checks if an object is considered empty, based on its type.
